name: check_leave_eligibility
description: check_leave_eligibility: Verify whether an employee meets FMLA eligibility requirements (12 months of employment, 1,250+ hours in the past year). Returns eligible: true, months employed, hours worked, and remaining FMLA weeks on success.

employee_id.description: The employee's ID. Format: EMP followed by 6 digits. Example: EMP048271
